6670.title: Path-installed plugin sources are deleted during workspace retirement
6670.rootCauseOneLine: Path installs retain disposable workspace roots; provider cleanup deletes them, while the source-loss warning reaches only the server logger.
6670.proposedFix: Choose an explicit source-lifetime policy and deliver any warning through SDK, CLI, and UI. No automatic PR: source promotion/refusal/retention requires a product decision, while warning delivery changes a public install contract.
6670.caveats: Focused in-process reproduction twice, using real source installation, host deletion, migrated SQLite, and runtime restart. Archive-to-removal chain is source-traced; browser/CLI archiving, scheduler timing, Windows, and original archive trigger were not exercised. Complete reproduction test and observations are inline in the report; no raw artifacts are published.
